query: NVIDIA Data Center revenue Q3 fiscal 2027 reported
normalized: 2027 center data fiscal nvidia q3 reported revenue

output.content:
NVIDIA has not yet reported Data Center revenue for Q3 fiscal 2027; its most recent reported quarter is Q2 fiscal 2027, ended July 26, 2026, when Data Center revenue was $89.0 billion. [[1]] 

For Q3 fiscal 2027, NVIDIA provided only total-company revenue guidance of $108.0 billion, plus or minus 2%, and explicitly said the outlook assumes no Data Center compute revenue from China. [[1]]

sources.title: NVIDIA Corporation - NVIDIA Announces Financial Results for Second Quarter Fiscal 2027
